cohort: The study included 622,073 children, categorized as offspring of mothers with type 1 diabetes (O-mT1D), offspring of fathers with type 1 diabetes (O-fT1D), and offspring from the background population (O-BP).
finding: Offspring of mothers with type 1 diabetes (O-mT1D) achieved lower school test scores compared to offspring from the background population (O-BP), but showed no significant difference in scores compared to offspring of fathers with type 1 diabetes (O-fT1D).
